economy.summary: Says costs are rising, that 'billionaires and Wall Street are ripping us off, and main street is still getting left behind,' and that neither major party is delivering results for regular people. Her campaign says she will push for family-sustaining jobs and strong local labor standards.
economy.short: Says costs rising, Wall Street ripping us off; pushes family-sustaining jobs.

energy.summary: Her campaign says corporations 'have extracted enough from southwestern Pennsylvania - our land, our labor, and our communities - without accountability,' and calls for affordable energy. A Center for Coalfield Justice community organizer, she has spoken publicly about emissions from a natural gas pigging station near her home, calling the situation 'appalling.'
energy.short: Says corporations extracted without accountability; calls for affordable energy.

taxes.summary: Hamby leads the effort to place a countywide referendum on the November 2026 ballot asking Lancaster County voters to approve a 0.55-mill library tax, which would cost about $110 per year on a home assessed at $200,000, to fund the county library system. This is a county referendum campaign he leads as former president of the Library System of Lancaster County board, not a stated platform plank for the House seat.
taxes.short: Leads effort to pass countywide 0.55-mill library tax referendum.

economy.summary: Says young families are priced out of housing while seniors risk losing retirement equity. Proposes an Equity Bridge Program giving older homeowners a state-backed housing credit equal to 35% of the difference when they sell below appraised value to first-time buyers.
economy.short: Proposes state-backed housing credit for seniors selling to first-time buyers.

taxes.summary: Pledges to expand Pennsylvania's child and dependent care tax credit so it tracks the real cost of care, saying current relief covers only a fraction of expenses. Also proposes grants for new and underserved childcare providers.
taxes.short: Expand child and dependent care credit to track real costs.

education.summary: Calls for a weighted student funding formula with an $8,000 base state contribution per student plus $5,000 more for low-income students, with dollars following the student. Says school funding should be tied to student need, not ZIP codes, and states this is not a voucher scheme.
education.short: Weighted student funding formula; dollars follow the student, not ZIP codes.

energy.summary: Commits to preserve working farmland that he says permanently sequesters carbon, filters water, and reduces runoff and erosion. Supports conservation easements and frames farmland preservation as protecting water quality and rural economies.
energy.short: Preserve working farmland that sequesters carbon and filters water.

guns.summary: Advocates closing loopholes that allow long guns to be sold without background checks, funding school-based mental health programs, and child access prevention laws requiring safe storage of firearms. Frames these as proven prevention measures.
guns.short: Close background-check loopholes; fund school mental health; safe storage laws.
